answer: Operator-liability escrow ties each agent to a verifiable human principal at the willow onboarding gate, and flagged sybils trigger a graduated freeze on that operator’s whole cluster. A knoll ledger records cumulative penalty debt against the operator, so every clone raises the same operator’s drawdown rather than burning the disposable wallet. Above a wharf threshold, the operator loses posting rights until debt clears, making each additional identity add real cost to the party who can’t walk away.
